data: {{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Republic |image=[[File:UkadoDayolm-AcolyteVG.png]] |name=Ukado Dayolm |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' |gender= |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes= |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]] **[[Galactic Senate]] |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Ukado Dayolm''' was the [[human]] [[senator]] for the affluent [[Uoti sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]], he was part of a tribunal reviewing the [[Mae's quest|murder]] of three [[Jedi]] and heard a report from [[Jedi Master]] [[Vernestra Rwoh]] in the [[Jedi Diplomatic Tower]] on the Republic [[capital]] [[Coruscant]]. Rwoh blamed the [[Death|murders]] on Jedi Master [[Sol]], although in truth they had been carried out by the [[Sith]]. ==Biography== Ukado Dayolm was a [[human]] who served as [[senator]] for the [[Uoti sector]] in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. Due to the [[sector]]'s affluence, he was used to making well-timed charitable donations to ease past [[Politics|political]] obstacles. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} Dayolm was part of a formal tribunal convened by [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Veeth Drellik]] to review the [[Jedi Order]]'s handling of the [[Mae's quest|murders]] of several [[Jedi]]. Drellik, Dayolm and the other senators involved in the tribunal met around a table in{{Acolyte|The Acolyte (episode)}} the [[Jedi Diplomatic Tower]] on the Republic's [[capital]], [[Coruscant]], where [[Jedi Master]] [[Vernestra Rwoh]] gave them a report on the situtation. Rwoh told the tribunal that Jedi Master [[Sol]] had gone rogue and [[Death|killed]] three other Jedi in order to cover up the four's involvement in the [[Mission to Brendok|destruction]] of a [[Brendok coven|Force cult]] on the [[planet]] [[Brendok]] [[148 BBY|sixteen years]] earlier. [[File:VernestraSenateTribunal-TheAcolyte.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Vernestra Rwoh, in white diplomatic robes, stands at the head of a long table with senators stood along each side. Ukado Dayolm stands directly to her right.|Ukado Dayolm heard from Vernestra Rwoh at a tribunal on Coruscant.]] However, this was a lie, as the three other Jedi had been killed by the [[Sith assassin|assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]]{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}} and her [[Sith Master]], the individual known as [[the Stranger]].{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}} Senator [[Worus Rayencourt]] called for an external review of the Jedi; however, Drellik asked what had become of Sol. Rwoh informed the tribunal that the Jedi had found Sol dead on Brendok and claimed that he had ended his own life. This was another lie, as Sol had been killed by his former [[Padawan]] [[Verosha Aniseya]]. ==Personality and traits== Dayolm had light skin and [[Color|black]] [[hair]]. ==Equipment== At the tribunal, Dayolm wore maroon and golden [[Clothing|robes]] with a golden decorative [[Belt|sash]] that also aided the senator's posture. ==Behind the scenes== Ukado Dayolm appeared in "[[The Acolyte (episode)|The Acolyte]]," the eighth episode of the [[Disney+]] live-action series of the [[Star Wars: The Acolyte|same name]], which aired on [[July 16]], [[2024]].{{D23|url=everything-coming-to-disney-in-july|text=Everything Coming to Disney+ in July 2024}} The character was not identified in the episode but was named in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Ukado Dayolm}} *{{Acolyte|The Acolyte (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{ThisWeek|e6uYc0Yl0vU|Dispatch: The Stranger and The Acolyte}} {{Video}} *{{SW|url=news/ilm-the-acolyte-vfx-interview|text=Lightsabers & Magic: Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy on The Acolyte's Creatures and Weapons of the Jedi}} {{Po}} *{{SWYouTube|9ajCIM6U5UA|The Acolyte | The Costumes of The Acolyte | Disney+}} {{Video}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Ukado Dayolm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უკადო დეიოლმი }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Dayolm, Ukado}} [[Category:Galactic Republic senators during the High Republic Era]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
